transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we discussed, the annual emergency evacuation exercise needs to be completed during the fall term, and I'll be giving final approval to the plan. The draft currently calls for a standard evacuation alarm, assembly in the east courtyard, and a general family notice. Before I can approve it, school policy requires me to review the plan with the nurse, counselor, facilities manager, and family liaison. I'd like to go through the plan with each of you today so we can address any concerns and move toward approval.
